LESSON: KUANDIKA 11.3.1 BARUA RASMI

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada
2. kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi muundo na mtindo ufaao ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi muundo na mtindo ufaao ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi muundo na mtindo ufaao ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi.
4. Show that you can: kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada
2. kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi muundo na mtindo ufaao ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
